changelog: v0.6.0: 1) Client-Server Architecture: Introduced standalone cross-platform server in server/ compatible with Windows, Mac (Apple Silicon/Intel), and Linux; 2) Single Source of Truth: Core agent personas, sliding-window dialogue memory, and tools registry are shared 100% without code duplication; 3) Local PC Server Engine Mode in Quest 3 settings with custom host/IP input and real-time connectivity testing; 4) Automated dual-mode test suite verifying both in-browser merged mode and client-server remote mode.
